title: Has anyone seen or heard of a Brazillian (Portuguese) or Spanish RPG Maker community?

posts.author: DrFreeman
posts.body:
I was first introduced to RPG Maker from a Brazillian developer and I recently ran across another making a plugin. Are there any groups or forums out there?
I found one:
https://centrorpg.com/index.php?PHPSESSID=d74eb44fa854a56a6d25f13b8e8a36d2&action=forum#c1

posts.author: DevRPG2k
posts.body:
This link doesn't work.
This Brazilian forum, like others, is still online, but the members aren't very active.
Most of us have migrated to DISCORD, which is also quite inactive; most only post memes and conversations about the current state of video game companies.

posts.author: Eternidade_1
posts.body:
There were several Brazilian communities back in the VX era, but then they all fell apart.
https://condadobraveheart.com/
is still up and running.
https://aldeiarpgbr.forumeiros.com/forum
has been around for a while, I don't know how it's doing.
Searching, you'll find some that are new, at least to me.
